titulo: A page while the pot boils
caption:
A page while the pot boils

The pot needed four minutes, so she gave them a page. The lid rattled just as she turned it.

The minutes of waiting are free, and one page a day adds up to a book before the year ends.

For whoever reads a page while the water boils.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a long counter. On it a closed blue book at the middle and a soup pot with a lid at the right. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and the book opens and a page turns. Then the pot lid lifts and steam rises, and its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me: standing here, waiting, to: one page while it boils.
